body.statement: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal P_{C^2}\), the local-linear construction satisfies \(\|\widehat e/e-1\|_\infty+\|\widehat\mu_0-\mu_0\|_\infty+\|\widehat\mu_1-\mu_1\|_\infty=O_P(r_n)\), with \(r_n=(\log n/n)^{2/(5+\kappa_+)}\), and its centered fitted score differs from the centered oracle score by \(o_P(\sigma_n/\sqrt n)\) when \(h_n\to0\) and by \(o_P(a_n/n)\) when \(h_n\) is bounded away from zero, including \(h_n\to\infty\). On every separated Gaussian sequence \(h_n\leq\eta_n\to0\), the explicit empirical score variance satisfies \(\widehat\sigma_n/\sigma_n\to_P1\). Consequently \(\widehat\psi_{\delta_n}\) inherits every branch of Theorem 1 without an assumed final remainder.
body.justification: The result turns the point-process law into a feasible nonparametric estimator and supplies the early kill test for the proposal.
body.gap: Ordinary DML controls fixed finite-variance scores in unweighted \(L_2\) norms; HiranoImbensRidder2003 and MaWang2020RobustIPW use regular or parametric first steps rather than relative-error boundary learning.
body.consumer: It gives a checkable learner implementation for the binary nuMoM2b outcome and a reference path for extending \(\mathtt{npcausal::ipsi}\).
